name: SPS Long Straight Section 4 (UA2 hall)
notes: REVIEW REQUIRED (A17 / honesty note): no official CERN page or archives-guide text fetched in this session states the Long Straight Section number (LSS4 vs LSS5) for UA1 or UA2 explicitly; both archives-guide pages were checked specifically for 'LSS', 'Long Straight Section', 'Point 4/5' wording and neither contains it. The LSS4-for-UA2 assignment follows the pre-existing reservation in docs/atlas-worklog/ID_REGISTRY.md, not an independently fetched source, so coordinates.confidence is 'uncertain' and the precision is set to cover the whole SPS ring.

Coordinates are the CERN Meyrin main-site geocoder point (site:cern-meyrin), reused as the best available anchor; precision_m 3000 is chosen to cover the ~7 km SPS ring, not a survey of the specific hall.

summary.plain: The underground hall on CERN's Super Proton Synchrotron ring where the UA2 detector sat to catch head-on collisions between protons and antiprotons.
summary.technical: One of the SPS's experimental insertion points, conventionally identified as Long Straight Section 4, where UA2 was installed around the beam pipe for the 1981-1990 SppS collider programme.
